input.objective: Deploy the NFT, vault, liquidity contract and renderer from this repository on Sepolia, in this order, with no changes to their logic: (1) TestSeats from src/testnet/TestSeats.sol with no constructor arguments; (2) InkPortraits with constructor ($owner); (3) InkVault with constructor ($contract:InkPortraits, $contract:TestSeats, $owner); (4) InkLiquidity with constructor (the official Uniswap v4 PoolManager on this chain, the official Uniswap v4 PositionManager on this chain, $owner, 0xbc10b3662231c830d2ee10bc6359db17bea4b3d4); (5) InkRenderer with constructor ($contract:InkPortraits, $owner). Run the existing Foundry tests before deploying. The treasury argument (0xbc10b3662231c830d2ee10bc6359db17bea4b3d4) only receives IMD fees and is not an owner. Owner roles and royalties must go to $owner, the address in the owner field, never to the deploying wallet or any swarm address. Do not add any other owner, admin or upgrade role.
